# neuron v0.1.0 â€” beta mk1

Windows 10/11 (x86_64) beta. The installer and portable ZIP both include the tray app and CLI. Neuron handles Razer device controls, profiles, remaps, lighting, macros, notifications, and audio without Synapse.

## Install

- Close Synapse, then install or extract Neuron and launch the app. Autostart is off by default. Enabling it from the SYSTEM page requires one administrator launch.
- Config stays beside the app. Set `NEURON_RUN_DIR` to put it elsewhere.
- The Windows builds are unsigned, so SmartScreen may prompt. Check `SHA256SUMS.txt`; `SOURCE.txt` names the source commit. The assets were built locally, without provenance attestation.

## Hardware tested

- **Naga V2 Pro and BlackWidow Chroma V2:** device controls verified on hardware.
- **BlackShark V2 with its included USB sound card, and Seiren V3 Mini:** also tested. Neuron has no device-specific features for these audio devices.

## Limits

- See [current status](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md) for feature maturity and known gaps.
- In-game hi-res polling, scroll stage tables, and snap-tap writes remain gated pending wire captures. Onboard button remapping and debounce have no trusted opcode, so Neuron refuses those writes. Synapse import reads plaintext exports, not encrypted cloud profiles. Macros run unsandboxed CPython.
- **Linux is deferred.** Its CLI builds and passes the local suite, but this release has no Linux download. Work on live remaps, audio, gestures, and the GUI overlay is in [codex/linux-runtime-parity](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/tree/codex/linux-runtime-parity). The overlay does not yet match Windows, and Linux input has not been verified on real Razer hardware. No macOS build.

Input synthesis starts disarmed. `neuron run --safe` logs actions without sending them. Device writes are read back and default to volatile; `neuron scroll` stores onboard by default (`--volatile` opts out).

To uninstall, use Windows Settings or delete the portable folder. If you enabled autostart, also remove its scheduled task with `schtasks /delete /tn "Neuron (elevated tray)" /f` from an administrator terminal.
